tables.name: sculptor_caliper_set
tables.units: mm (3D chord between skin landmarks, live caliper); live_sigma = repeatability of one careful reading, not population SD
rows: bitragion breadth (ear hole to ear hole)
tables.population: Young adults (about 18-30 y), North American White-type means, consistent with anatomy/anthropometric-norms.md; other populations shift (see that note's Table 5)
tables.notes: t-n, t-sn, t-gn and t-t ranges are reconstructed from typical head geometry, not read from Farkas tables: verify before using as priors. As population priors use sigma 6-8 mm for t-depths; tighten to the live_sigma only when the subject was measured. Pressed readings (zy, go, eu) need a positive offset to compare with an uncompressed 3D surface (see caliper_to_surface_offsets).

tables.name: contour_check_views
tables.units: degrees (yaw about the head's vertical axis, 0 = frontal; pitch positive = camera above looking down)
rows: cheekbone corner, mouth barrel, socket depth, nose vs cheek
cheekbone corner, mouth barrel, socket depth, nose vs cheek
profile line, ear position, face depth
profile line, ear position, face depth
cranial plan, forehead curve, nose projection vs cheeks, ear set-back (pitch range 45-90)
jaw, chin, nose underside, neck (pitch range -30 to -45)
tables.notes: Classic turntable practice: 8 yaw steps of 45 deg, refined to 16 steps of 22.5 deg, plus above and below. Pitch values for above/below are representative midpoints of the stated ranges. A missing view must be reported as prior-only, never counted as agreement.

tables.name: scale_and_material_compensation
tables.units: linear scale factor (dimensionless); shrink as fraction of linear size
rows: so it does not read small indoors; convention varies
scale model up by 1/(1-s); confirm with clay body and kiln
tables.notes: Use for an output_scale / material_shrink export parameter. All ranges are expert knowledge and should be checked with the supplier, kiln or foundry.

rows: photo as camera background; A/B blink

one area light matched to photo key
flat black-on-white silhouette per solved camera
treat photo as ortho only beyond this subject distance

tables.notes: Engineering proposals mapping traditional checks to defaults; blur and thumbnail values match community/likeness-mistakes.md.

tables.name: landmark_tiers_caliper_sigma
rows: n, t, ex, en, prn, sn, pg, gn, zy, go, sa, sba
one-sided bounds only (scalp inside hair silhouette); never for scale
tables.population: adults, live caliper by a careful operator
tables.notes: Caliper technical error of measurement in non-expert hands is an open question; widen by ~1.5x for a first-time operator.

tables.name: caliper_to_surface_offsets
tables.units: mm (add to pressed caliper reading to estimate uncompressed surface chord, both sides combined)
rows: soft tissue over zygomatic arch compressed by caliper tips
masseter and fat compressed; photo silhouette jaw width is larger still (see anthropometric-norms Table 6)
scalp only; hair adds more in photos
tables.notes: Starting values for the o_ab term in E_cal; to be calibrated against paired caliper/3D-scan data.
